LanguageData.LP_Setting_LearningWeightDescription: Controls how often playground play is chosen as a child's learning desire. Higher values make children want playground play more often.
LanguageData.LP_Setting_LearningWeightTip: 1 gives playground play the same draw weight as ordinary activities such as floor drawing and nature running. 2 doubles that weight, not the actual number of visits. This does not affect the 50% chance to play during idle time. Changes apply to the next learning-desire draw; existing desires and play in progress are kept.
LanguageData.LP_Setting_LearningWeightTiming: Applies when a new learning desire is chosen. Existing desires and play in progress are kept.
